DamageMeter.name: 皮皮统计: Skada
DamageMeter.changelog: 适配 v0.113.0 商店与地图决策采集
changelog_detail: 兼容新版购买入口和商品列表返回类型，避免漏挂钩或重复采集。
多人地图重复点击按真实投票判断，首领记录使用地图节点实际显示内容；保留 v0.107.1 正式版兼容。
受保护版本已通过新版游戏的伤害统计与商店操作检查；保留 v0.107.1 接口兼容。另包含此前开发的可选决策记录及用途告知，不代表真实训练数据验收或模型质量结论。
DamageMeter.changelog_en: Adapt shop and map decision capture to v0.113.0
changelog_detail_en: Resolve the new purchase entry point and shop-list return type without missed hooks or duplicate capture.
Use actual map votes and rendered boss nodes; retain official v0.107.1 compatibility.

The protected build passed v0.113.0 damage-meter and shop smoke tests, with v0.107.1 interface compatibility retained. Includes previously developed optional decision capture and purpose notices; this is not acceptance of real training data or a model-quality claim.

SpeedX.name: 皮皮极速: SpeedX
SpeedX.changelog: 降低伤害预览分配开销，修复超时保护、自动结束预测与设置保存
changelog_detail: 不再缩短等待战斗目标出现的容错超时；正常动作与视觉加速保持可用。
缓存预览颜色、节点路径和不变的显示数据；及时释放临时目标与覆盖层，恢复格挡文字颜色时保留其他覆盖。伤害仍按当前战斗状态计算。
自动结束回合仅在最终决策时进行安全预测，不再在倒计时内逐帧重算；单次预测复用监听对象，先前减伤已归零时不再误耗缓冲。
补齐快捷出牌开关的 ModConfig 持久化，避免不变设置反复触发回调，注册失败时不再误判为可用；悬浮布局按变化刷新，降低回溯统计查询频率。
新增定向回归与故障反例测试；受保护版本已完成本地实机测试并通过新日志校验。
SpeedX.changelog_en: Reduce preview allocations and fix timeout, auto-end safety and settings persistence
changelog_detail_en: Stop accelerating creature-lookup safety timeouts; normal action and visual acceleration remain available.

Cache preview colors, node paths and unchanged presentation data; release temporary targets and overlay nodes at lifecycle boundaries, and restore block text color without discarding other overrides. Damage is still computed from live state.
Run auto-end safety forecasts at the final decision rather than every countdown frame, reuse listeners within each forecast, and preserve Buffer when earlier reductions already eliminate HP loss.

Persist the quick-play toggle through ModConfig, avoid unchanged setting callbacks, and treat failed registration as unavailable. Refresh overlay layout on changes and reduce Rewind statistics polling.
Add focused regression and negative-fixture coverage. The protected build has completed local in-game testing and passed fresh-log verification.

RemoveMultiplayerPlayerLimit.name: Remove Multiplayer Player Limit
RemoveMultiplayerPlayerLimit.changelog: 适配 v0.99 beta 新 mod 结构
changelog_detail: 新增 v0.99 格式 manifest（外部 JSON + id + affects_gameplay）
多人联机 API 无破坏性变更，Harmony patches 全部兼容

Rewind.name: 皮皮倒带: Rewind
Rewind.changelog: 修复测试版倒带经过选牌时黑屏、停在旧回合的问题
changelog_detail: 从刚重建的单人战局绑定选牌记录，不再等待尚未就绪的本地玩家标识。无法绑定时立即报告失败，不再遮住界面等待玩家重复选牌。
Rewind.changelog_en: Replay historical card choices on the beta branch without reopening the selector
changelog_detail_en: Bind replay choices to the rebuilt single-player session before room entry. If its selector cannot be installed, fail immediately rather than waiting behind the rewind overlay.

ModConfig.name: 皮皮配置: ModConfig
ModConfig.changelog: 接入发布保护并固定正式版编译基线
changelog_detail: 保留配置注册接口、配置项属性、枚举字段与快捷键节点回调，公开包改用验证后的受保护程序集。
固定 v0.107.1 编译引用，并支持不覆盖游戏文件的隔离构建；不改变配置格式和控件行为。
受保护版本已通过 v0.113.0 初始化、模组接口注册和设置页检查；配置格式与控件行为保持不变，编译基线为 v0.107.1。
ModConfig.changelog_en: Protect release artifacts and pin the official compile baseline
changelog_detail_en: Preserve the registration API, configuration properties, enum fields and key-capture callbacks in protected release assemblies.
Pin compilation to v0.107.1 and support isolated builds without overwriting game files; configuration formats and controls are unchanged.
The protected build passed v0.113.0 initialization, mod API registration and settings-screen checks. Configuration formats and controls are unchanged; compilation is pinned to v0.107.1.

QuickLink.name: 皮皮快连: QuickLink
QuickLink.changelog: 修复联机投票与标准局重开，避免普通事件结算后坏档
changelog_detail: 兼容其他模组在消息后追加数据；只认当前连接玩家自己的投票。标准局换种子不再触发自定义大厅回调；新档队伍可以从首幕地图正常开局。
普通事件跳过游戏读不回的结算态，古神多句对白不再卡住。重连时按 Esc 也会通知房主；取消不会把资源加载慢误判成同步失败。房主掉线时客机会退出同步；取消和断线同时发生时只返回一次主菜单。
QuickLink.changelog_en: Fix multiplayer voting and standard rerolls; avoid unloadable completed-event saves
changelog_detail_en: Read votes even with independent transport trailers and bind them to the connected peer. Standard rerolls no longer trigger custom-lobby callbacks, and fresh crews can start on the first map.

Skip unloadable ordinary-event snapshots and recognize multi-line Ancient dialogue. Esc also withdraws a pending rejoin. Slow asset loading does not consume the sync timeout; host loss ends the wait without restoring fake data, and overlapping menu returns share one transition.

SkadaHelper.name: 皮皮军师: SkadaHelper
SkadaHelper.changelog: 修复 v0.113 测试版有卡牌统计却不显示的问题
changelog_detail: 按实际游戏版本请求并校验卡牌统计，不再把 v0.113 一律判为暂无数据。下载正文卡住会超时并尝试备用地址，不覆盖已有缓存。没有对应版本的事件统计时不冒用其他版本。
正式版普通事件使用截至 2026-10-27（UTC）的真实历史对局；选项旁单独标明样本截止日期，不与卡牌统计混用。
SkadaHelper.changelog_en: Load published card statistics for v0.113 beta patches
changelog_detail_en: Fetch and validate the matching card statistics bundle on v0.113. Bound stalled response bodies and try the alternate origin without replacing valid cached data. Missing event statistics are not replaced with another cohort.
Standard-branch event options show historical observations through 2026-10-27 (UTC), labeled separately from card statistics.
